metadata.description: Curated protected gene list for K562 chronic myeloid leukemia cells. Genes listed here are force-included in SPORE HVG selection regardless of variance threshold. The Replogle 2022 dataset uses Ensembl gene IDs; translate this symbol list to Ensembl before loading. Now includes the 227-gene Tahoe-100M drug target cohort to ensure all druggable nodes are present in the GRN.

tier_definitions.1: Core master regulators. Their absence fundamentally distorts hematopoietic/CML GRN topology. Always rescue these first.
tier_definitions.2: Critical pathway nodes, chromatin regulators, and Tahoe drug targets. High-priority rescue.
tier_definitions.3: Extended regulatory context. Rescue when HVG budget allows.

metadata.selection_criterion: A gene is protected if: (a) it is a known TF or direct chromatin co-regulator in K562 cells AND (b) it is plausibly constitutively expressed (low variance), OR (c) it is a master regulator whose output spans many downstream targets, OR (d) it is a Tahoe-100M drug target gene.
metadata.notes: Gene symbols are HGNC standard. Replogle 2022 K562 datasets (K562_gwps and K562_essential) use Ensembl IDs. Translate before loading. K562 is a BCR-ABL+ CML line with erythroid/megakaryocytic differentiation capacity. SPORE will deduplicate genes that appear in multiple sections.

core_hematopoietic_tfs.rationale: The GATA1/GATA2/TAL1/KLF1/MYB axis defines K562 identity. MYB is the master regulator occupying ~1/3 of K562 super-enhancers (Lemma 2021). GATA1/TAL1 co-regulate erythroid genes and globin loci. RUNX1 and FLI1 are essential for megakaryocytic programs.

bcr_abl_signaling.rationale: K562 is defined by the BCR-ABL1 fusion oncogene. STAT5A/B are the primary transcriptional effectors of BCR-ABL signaling. ABL1 and BCR are often stably expressed and low-variance.

erythroid_megakaryocytic.rationale: K562 cells can differentiate along erythroid and megakaryocytic lineages. GFI1B is critical for erythroid silencing, LMO2 for TAL1 complex formation, LDB1 as bridging factor. IKZF1 (Ikaros) regulates lymphoid-to-myeloid fate decisions.

myeloid_lineage.rationale: Myeloid TFs that maintain K562 in the CML progenitor state. SPI1 (PU.1) and CEBPA define the myeloid program. IRF8 drives monocytic commitment.

signaling_pathways.rationale: Key signaling mediators downstream of BCR-ABL and growth factor receptors. STAT3, MAPK, PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathways are constitutively active in K562.

chromatin_epigenetic.rationale: Chromatin regulators with known K562 ChIP-seq data in ENCODE. BRD4 occupies super-enhancers at MYB and GATA loci. EZH2/PRC2 silences developmental programs. KAT2A and EP300 are co-activators at hematopoietic enhancers.

polycomb_trithorax.rationale: PRC2 maintains bivalent chromatin at lineage-specifying loci in K562 progenitors. KMT2A (MLL) rearrangements are common in leukemia and KMT2A targets overlap with MYB targets.

swi_snf_remodeling.rationale: SWI/SNF (BAF) complexes maintain accessible chromatin at GATA1 and MYB binding sites. SMARCA4 (BRG1) is essential for erythroid gene activation in K562.

cell_cycle_apoptosis.rationale: K562 lacks functional TP53 (homozygous deletion) but retains RB1. Cell cycle and apoptosis regulators are critical for CML proliferation. BCL2 and MCL1 are targets of BCR-ABL survival signaling.

rna_processing_splicing.rationale: RNA splicing factors are recurrently mutated in myeloid malignancies and are essential genes in K562 (Replogle DepMap). SF3B1, U2AF1, SRSF2 are stably expressed and often below HVG variance thresholds.

chromatin_architecture.rationale: CTCF and cohesin organize TADs and enhancer-promoter loops at hematopoietic loci. Constitutively expressed and typically filtered by variance-based HVG selection.

tahoe_drug_targets.rationale: 227 human gene targets from the Tahoe-100M drug perturbation atlas (Tahoe Therapeutics / Arc Institute, 2025). These are the protein targets of 236 clinically relevant small-molecule drugs across cancer-relevant pathways (CDK4/6, MTOR, PI3K, MAPK, BRAF, EGFR, HDAC, PARP, BCL2, PLK1, TOP1/2, proteasome, JAK/STAT, tubulin, etc.). Force-including these genes ensures every FUNGI-derived GRN contains the druggable nodes needed for downstream drug-response analysis using the Tahoe-100M data. SPORE will deduplicate any genes that also appear in other protected categories. WNV NS2B-NS3 (a viral protease target) is excluded as it has no human orthologue.
